terms.comment: To bend the bow, arcum intendere (Lewis & Short). Also the rainbow and an arch.

phrases.latin: haec cernēns arcum intendēbat Apollō dēsuper
phrases.english: seeing this, Apollo was bending his bow from above
… or shooting with a pop-gun and a bow …

sources: Lewis & Short: arcus
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 45.
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-comenius), checked against the editions named there.
